title: Submission
description: Canonical submission shape. rater/ingest.py is lenient: keys are matched case-insensitively and through the aliases listed per field; only usdot is needed to get a decision. Everything else is coerced, defaulted, and the assumption recorded in the result's flags.

submission_id.description: Optional label. Aliases: id, name, carrier_name, legal_name. Default: sub-<usdot>.

usdot.description: USDOT number. Aliases: dot, dot_number, usdot_number, us_dot. Non-digits are stripped ('USDOT 1234' -> 1234). Missing -> decline D01.

drivers.description: One object per driver. A bare number or numeric string is accepted as a count. Missing -> FMCSA census driver count.

driver_count.description: Alternative to drivers[]. Aliases: num_drivers, number_of_drivers, total_drivers.

units.description: Power units. Aliases: vins, vehicles, trucks. Items may be {vin: ...} or bare VIN strings; a bare integer is accepted as a unit count with no VINs. Invalid VINs are flagged and skipped. Missing -> FMCSA census power-unit count.

power_units.description: Optional unit count (aliases: unit_count, num_units, truck_count) or a VIN list. If it disagrees with the VIN list the larger number is rated and a flag is set.

radius.description: Operating radius band. Aliases: operating_radius, radius_miles. Also accepts local/intermediate/regional/long_haul, a number of miles (<=50 local, <=200 intermediate, <=500 regional, else long haul) or '300 miles'. Missing -> intermediate.

commodity.description: Hauled commodity (dry_van, reefer, flatbed, general_freight, building_materials, machinery_heavy, grain_feed, logs_lumber, intermodal). Aliases: cargo, commodity_type, freight. Hazmat / tanker / passenger / HHG / auto hauler / livestock / oilfield / garbage -> decline D11. Missing -> unknown (1.10).

garaging_state.description: Two-letter state. Aliases: state, domicile_state, phy_state. Missing -> FMCSA physical state.

insurance_history.description: Self-declared. cancellation_24m true -> decline D23 (L&I automation is roadmap item 2).
